moods.mood_description: The emperor's inner war resolves in clemency and stone
From sword to dharma: the arc is complete
Repetition and reinforcement of compassion as public ethics
The frame returns to the hill and the final chisel stroke
The edict stands; the reader is left with the echo
Can an empire founded in blood be re-founded in regret?
The sound of the chisel echoes into the present
Whether regret, repeated often enough, becomes a kind of love
